findings.issue: Sprint r-7 touches the REQ-SAG-0143 subject. It has owned paths in sc-jev (client/mod.rs:121 'body built as String') and sc-jev-backends (backend.rs:126). It also carries jev::v1 in sc-decision-schema unchanged. REQ-SAG-0143 defines the CheckRequest/CheckResponse body path that these owned paths touch. The id is absent from the front-matter requirements list. This is not a carry-forward item. It is raised under the Blocking rule for a missing listed id, and the parent may treat it as a new finding in this locked round.

gate_reason: FAIL on one Blocking finding, REQ-QA-005: REQ-SAG-0143 is touched by r-7 owned paths but is not in the front-matter requirements list. All four carry-forward findings are closed or justified. REQ-QA-001 (duplicate REQ-SAG-0130) is justified by the repo's same-id amendment convention, with the same reuse for 0103, 0107, 0601 and 0711, and the sprint disambiguates each use. REQ-QA-002 and REQ-QA-003 are closed by the architecture and plan item 12 wording, which now lists sc-jev-py with rationale and hosts per-API modules in sc-decision-schema. REQ-QA-004 is closed by sprint lines 202-204. No regression was found in the re-read targets. Completion is 7 of 8 (87.5%), not 100%. If the parent rules that 0143 is outside r-7's touched subjects, REQ-QA-005 can be withdrawn and the gate would PASS, but that ruling is not mine to make.
